en: Ben, how have you seen Travis evolve since you first got to know him?

en: We have a lot of repeat entrepreneurs in the room in terms of when, like Travis, you have a massive success that also has some mistakes along the way.

en: What lessons do you learn for the next time versus what do you make sure to keep and continue because that's what got you there?
zh: 你下次会吸取什么教训，以及你会确保保留并继续什么，因为那是让你走到这一步的原因？

en: Well, I thought that was actually a really good way to characterize it, which was, you know, he thought he was in survival mode when he had 20,000 people working for him and that idea is dangerous when you have such a big organization.
zh: 嗯，我认为这实际上是一个很好的描述方式，也就是，你知道，他以为自己在生存模式，当时有 20,000 人为他工作，当你有这么大的组织时，这种想法是危险的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's dangerous on two levels.
zh: 它在两个层面上是危险的。

speaker: Unknown
en: One, it's dangerous because you're not, as he said, bringing enough people along with you, but it's also dangerous in that you've got all these people working for you.
zh: 第一，它很危险，因为正如他所说，你没有带足够多的人一起走，但它也很危险，因为你有这么多人替你工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And their interpretation of that idea could be a lot.
zh: 而且他们对那个想法的解读可能有很多种。

en: You know, you kind of have to, you have to stay way on this side of the line so the guy, you know, eight levels down doesn't do something stupid.

en: And so that, you know, that's a big change, I would say.

en: But, like, he was always great.

en: Always.

en: Yeah, and I think like when you do get, I think everything comes easier.
zh: 是的，我认为就像当你真的得到时，我认为一切都变得更容易了。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the Prince line?
zh: Prince 是怎么说的？

speaker: Unknown
en: People say nothing comes too easy, but when you got it, nothing comes too hard.
zh: 人们说没有什么是来得太容易的，但当你拥有它时，没有什么是太难的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's like, that's where he got to.
zh: 这就像，这就是他达到的境界。

speaker: Unknown
en: The one thing to add to it though, and again, I feel like I don't want to prescribe to folks, like everybody, a lot of folks here already know this, but it's like,

en: When it gets easy, it's time to push hard.
zh: 当事情变得容易时，是时候努力推动了。

en: I always used to say, like, if it's getting easy, it's about to get really fucking hard.
zh: 我过去常说，如果事情变得容易，就快变得真他妈难了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you don't want it to be that way.
zh: 你不希望它是那样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You want to make it hard versus hard make it hard on you, if that makes sense.
zh: 你想让它变难，而不是让它对你变难，如果这有道理的话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I talked to a lot of entrepreneurs over the years where they're like, oh man, we're just cranking, we're on easy street right now.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, dude, you are about to get your ass whooped and you don't even know it.

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, bro, check yourself for wounds, because I assure you, you're bleeding, you know, like you're in trouble.
zh: 我会说，兄弟，检查一下你的伤口，因为我向你保证，你在流血，你知道，就像你有麻烦了。

speaker: Unknown
en: For sure.
zh: 当然。

speaker: Unknown
en: But there's times when it's actually easy.
zh: 但确实有实际上容易的时候。

speaker: Unknown
en: But there's actual times when it's easy, but it's because you're not continuing to push.

en: Yeah.

en: Many such cases.
zh: 很多这样的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, for sure.
zh: 是的，当然。

zh: 就像当我们，我的意思是，我是 Lyft 的董事会成员，我和他谈论 Uber，他会告诉我那些中国打车公司对他做的所有事情，闯入他的应用，免费送东西，这个那个各种各样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he was fired up about that.
zh: 他对此非常激动。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, oh, if I can deal with these guys, the rest of the world is going to be no problem.

speaker: Unknown
